versions.localizedDescription:
Photoroom is the ultimate AI-powered photo editing app, trusted by over 300 million users.

Create studio-quality product photos in seconds with Photoroom’s advanced AI photo editing technology. No design skills required.


WHY CHOOSE PHOTOROOM?

ENHANCE PRODUCT LISTINGS. Showcase clothing on virtual models, ghost mannequins, and flat lay. No studio required.

REMOVE, REPLACE, AND RECOLOR. Remove backgrounds, swap for AI-generated edits, and recolor products in seconds.

SAVE TIME WITH BATCH EDITING. Edit your entire product catalog at once.

CONNECT TO SHOPIFY. Create SEO-optimised listings and sync directly to Shopify.

SELL ON EVERY MARKETPLACE. Export images sized for Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, Depop, Poshmark, Vinted, Instagram
